svg.aria-label: Friedel-Crafts acylation of benzene to acetophenone
svg.title: Friedel-Crafts acylation of benzene to acetophenone

g.text: Synthesis of acetophenone from benzene: Friedel–Crafts acylation
Only one acyl group enters: the C=O group deactivates the ring, so poly-acylation does not occur (unlike Friedel–Crafts alkylation).
